newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket - Kambli shines for India A vs South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Kambli shines for India A vs South Africa.

text.p: A cavalier innings by Indian test discard Vinod Kambli, who cracked 98 runs off 101 balls, was the highlight of the second day's of a three-day game between an Indian A selection and South Africa.
At the close, the tourists had scored 33 runs without losing a wicket in their second innings after bowling out the Indian side for 340 runs in their first innings to take a 44 run lead.
Kambli hammered the South African bowling to hit seven sixes and 11 fours. Four of his sixes came off successive balls, three off left-arm spinner Paul Adams and one off Derek Crookes.
For the South Africans, Adams took five wickets for 108 runs while Klusener had two for 38 and Crookes two for 45.
At close of play, Brian McMillan was not out on 15 and Herschelle Gibbs on 18.
Earlier South Africa declared their first innings closed at their overnight score of 384 for five.
